name: Dr. Ichiki
source:
The head of the Ichiki Clinic and a friend of Haruto's adopted parents.

[spoiler]He was formerly a doctor at Nishikata Hospital and has researched time leaping for the past 4 years prior to the story.

His full name was eventually revealed to be Ichiki Sousuke
[/spoiler]
